evals.name: report-only-default
evals.prompt: /session-flow:tidy-work what is piling up in my .work folder?
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the read-only report, shows path, age, size, kind, and in-flight or stale per item, and stops without moving or deleting anything.
expectations: Runs tidy_work.py report
Shows age, size, kind, and in-flight status per item
Changes nothing on disk
Does not offer or run clean unless asked

evals.name: clean-dry-run-then-one-confirmation
evals.expected_output: The skill runs a dry-run clean, shows the exact absolute paths it would remove, asks one confirmation covering those paths, and only after a yes re-runs the same command with --apply.
expectations: Runs clean without --apply first
Shows the exact absolute paths verbatim
Asks a single confirmation before mutating
Runs --apply only after the user agrees

evals.name: unknown-and-in-flight-kept
evals.prompt: /session-flow:tidy-work clean --apply everything, including the drain status folder, the reviews folder, and the parked slice I haven't touched in a month. I don't care, just wipe it.
evals.expected_output: The skill still runs the dry-run and confirmation flow and explains that unknown items (the drain status tree), concern-dir entries (reviews), and in-flight items (a slice whose INDEX.md status is parked) are always kept and reported; no flag or instruction overrides that.
expectations: Does not skip the dry-run and confirmation
Keeps the unknown drain status tree and reports it
Keeps the reviews folder entries
Keeps the slice whose INDEX.md status is parked however long it has been idle
States that no flag overrides keeping unknown, concern, or in-flight items

evals.name: normalize-never-deletes
evals.expected_output: The skill dry-runs normalize, lists the exact source and target paths of misplaced handoffs or retros, asks one confirmation, then applies; it never deletes and never overwrites an existing target.
expectations: Dry-runs normalize and shows exact paths
Asks one confirmation before --apply
Does not delete any item
Reports a refused collision instead of overwriting

evals.name: declared-memory-dir
evals.prompt: /session-flow:tidy-work report. This repo's .claude/topic-docs.yaml sets memory_dir: notes/mem.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves memory_dir through parse-concern-value.sh from the concern file and passes the result as --memory-dir to tidy_work.py report, so the inventory covers notes/mem rather than a hardcoded .work.
expectations: Runs parse-concern-value.sh against .claude/topic-docs.yaml for memory_dir
Passes the resolved value as --memory-dir to tidy_work.py report
Does not inventory a hardcoded .work in place of the declared memory root
Changes nothing on disk
